rules.description: Applicant must hold an eligible visa type for ILR
rules.reason_if_failed: Your current visa type is not eligible for ILR. Check which visa routes lead to settlement.

rules.description: Applicant must have completed the qualifying period for their visa type
rules.reason_if_failed: You must complete the required qualifying period on an eligible visa (usually 5 years, sometimes 2-3 years for Tier 1 or Global Talent)

rules.description: Applicant must meet continuous residence requirement
rules.reason_if_failed: You have spent more than 180 days outside the UK in a 12-month period, breaking continuous residence

rules.description: Applicant must meet the good character requirement
rules.reason_if_failed: Your criminal record may affect your application. This requires case-by-case assessment.

rules.description: Applicant must not have recent immigration breaches
rules.reason_if_failed: Previous immigration breaches (overstaying, working without permission) may affect your application

rules.description: Applicant must meet income requirements if applying through family route
rules.reason_if_failed: Family visa routes require minimum income of £29,000 per year (or £34,500 with children)

explanation_template: Indefinite Leave to Remain eligibility: {outcome}. Required: eligible visa, qualifying period complete, continuous residence maintained, good character.

edge_cases.description: Applicant's relationship ended due to domestic violence
edge_cases.action: Route to domestic violence concession pathway. Different evidence requirements apply. No income requirement.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has refugee status or humanitarian protection
edge_cases.action: Separate ILR pathway for refugees. Usually eligible after 5 years. No income requirement.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has 10+ years continuous lawful residence
edge_cases.action: Route to 10-year long residence pathway. Different continuous residence rules may apply.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has served in UK armed forces
edge_cases.action: Expedited pathway for armed forces personnel. Check eligibility for immediate ILR in some cases.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has unspent criminal conviction or prison sentence over 12 months
edge_cases.action: Automatic refusal likely. Hand off to immigration lawyer. Consider Rehabilitation of Offenders Act timescales.

edge_cases.description: Absences exceed 180 days but for compelling reasons (serious illness, family emergency)
edge_cases.action: Discretionary consideration may apply. Hand off to case worker with full explanation and evidence.
